title: Find median from stream
statementMd:
Process `nums` one at a time; after each number output the median of all numbers seen so far (as a float for even counts).

**Example:** `stream_medians([1, 2, 3])` returns `[1.0, 1.5, 2.0]`.
hints: Two heaps: lower half (max-heap) and upper half (min-heap).
solutionMd:
```python
def stream_medians(nums):
    import heapq
    lo, hi = [], []
    out = []
    for x in nums:
        heapq.heappush(lo, -x)
        heapq.heappush(hi, -heapq.heappop(lo))
        if len(hi) > len(lo):
            heapq.heappush(lo, -heapq.heappop(hi))
        out.append(float(-lo[0]) if len(lo) > len(hi) else (-lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2)
    return out
```

Keep the halves balanced.
referenceSolution:
def stream_medians(nums):
    import heapq
    lo, hi = [], []
    out = []
    for x in nums:
        heapq.heappush(lo, -x)
        heapq.heappush(hi, -heapq.heappop(lo))
        if len(hi) > len(lo):
            heapq.heappush(lo, -heapq.heappop(hi))
        out.append(float(-lo[0]) if len(lo) > len(hi) else (-lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2)
    return out
